caveats: Registered official horizons plus one; all remaining cases assumed to time out.
Ongoing incomplete batches are not credited partial progress, making remaining nominal work conservative in that respect only.
Completed samples are biased to earlier shorter tasks; these are workload scenarios, not a confidence interval or guaranteed ETA.
Batch seconds include stock evaluator.run, simulator steps, policy inference, video and reset as actually measured; excludes initial scene setup.
Setup measured from part start to first attempt, including currently running scenes; additional shared FIFO waiting, later shutdown, archive finalization and new faults are not modelled.
Per-card scheduling preserves original partitions; no restart, shortened horizon, policy change, or model selection.
The first slow popcorn batch is now in the sample, but future heavy tasks can still take longer; the scenario endpoints are not an upper bound.
MEM estimate is still the earlier same-schedule public-throughput scenario; handoff reload, final archive time and deferred model delivery are not included.
